data.text:
No hazard found - trigger appears benign.

- S1 (Rack A inlet) has repeated 26.77°C for the last ~12-15 min, suggesting a stuck sensor. All other sensors are live and normal: S2 ~26.2°C, S3 ~23.7°C, M1 ~4.46 kW stable, M2 ~56 mV normal/noisy.
- Sensor metadata does not yet flag S1 as flat, but history shows 4 identical samples.
- Physics fit: p(none)=0.79, p(fault)=0.21 (vent_rackB 0.11, vent_rackA 0.05, AC 0.04). Model adequate, no rising trends.
- Hidden-zone regression: rackB ~29±2°C (6°C margin to 35°C limit), desk2 ~26.3°C, connector ~30°C - all well within simulated limits.

Action: No mitigation requested. Sent info alert for S1 visual / maintenance check. Continue routine monitoring; re-investigate if S2/S3/M1/M2 drift or S1 remains flat.

data.text:

Other sensors normal: S2/S3 flat trends, M1 ~4.5kW stable, M2 elevated ~95mV with upward trend.

Physics diagnosis: p_fault=1, posterior 1.0 for Rack B load increase to ~1.24x ~16min ago. No AC/vent fault. If nothing done over 90min: p_breach=0, peak margin -4.7C (within limits).

Hidden-zone regression agrees: rackB 29±2C (limit 35), desk2 26.3C, connector 30.4C - all within limits.

Conclusion: benign trigger apart from faulty S1. No limit breach plausible, so no warn/critical and no hazard action requested. Info alert sent. Recommend maintenance/recalibration of S1 (374 days since cal).

data.text:
Trigger is benign - stuck sensor, not a hazard:

- S1 (Rack A inlet) is exactly 26.77C for ~30 min, std 0, flat_suspect true. Untrustworthy, excluded from diagnosis.
- Other sensors normal: S2 ~26.4C, S3 ~23.9C, M1 ~4.55 kW stable, M2 noisy but no rising trend.
- Physics diagnosis: P(no fault)=0.825, P(fault)=0.175 split across small vent/AC hypotheses. Model fits well. No breach predicted in 90 min if nothing done.
- Hidden-zone regression: rackB 29.5C +/-2 (limit 35), desk2 26.2C, connector 30.8C - all within limits.

No hazard action needed. Sent info alert for S1 maintenance/recalibration (374 days since cal). Recommend human check/replace S1 and continue monitoring; escalate if S2/S3 rise or M1/M2 drift.
